aria-describedby.description: Forwarded to the root — set by Tooltip when Avatar is its trigger (e.g. inside AvatarGroup). Screen-reader only.

Components on a native element accept them without declaring them; only Avatar (a <span>) and Tooltip declare aria-describedby, so it can be a Tooltip trigger.
